# html end-to-end: state-only assertions via sngl test --platform=html.
# Skips cleanly when Chrome/Chromium isn't on PATH (launcher returns
# codegen.SkipError, driver surfaces it as a passing TestResult with
# SKIP log — stdout 'PASS' matches).

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl://std"

output { none { html } }

component main {
    var count = 0
    text(value=string(count))
}

func testInitial(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.count == 0)
}
